snippet.text: theorem zStress_identity {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsOpen S) (h : ℝ) (f : SlowProfiles) (n : ℕ) (hF : SlowStressSupport.Smooth S (zDensity h f n)) {w : InnerPoint} (hX : 0 < w.1) (heta : w.2 ∈ S) : Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) * partialX (zStress h f n) w + zStress h f n w / Real.sqrt (2 * w.1) = -axialCoefficient h f n w
